measured_evidence.note: Flash migration: five exact read-only resource sections (31,406 B) move to .extflash byte-identically and the packed main drops 40,960 B to 958,464 B, leaving the same amount under the unchanged 999,424 B target; extension uses 380,192 B with 606,944 B spare. RAM layout and menu selection are unchanged. The exact libm table has 29 members and is added only for a non-empty catalogue selection (no whole-library pattern); the default-six profile emits no math patterns, so its larger main image is not evidence of a missing game. All-27, default6 and single-ardubullets real split builds pass; audio is the shared bounded mono adapter over app/tone. Only 21 catalogue ports plus Hopper use on-demand States; five built-ins keep static engines. Host State/save peak is not target heap; runtime heap, fragmentation and simultaneous suspended states remain unmeasured on the watch.
